name: United States Veterans Initiative: veteran housing help (SSVF)
description: VA-funded Supportive Services for Veteran Families (SSVF, grant 18-HI-190): case management, help keeping a home, rapid rehousing and short-term financial help for low-income veteran households. Serves: Hawaii County, Honolulu County, Kalawao County, Kauai County, Maui County.
next_step: Call SSVF intake with your county and housing situation: whether you are homeless now or at risk of losing housing, and who lives with you. A second intake number is listed: 808-953-9358.
constraints: Serves only the areas listed; check that yours is included. Veteran-household, income and housing-status screening applies.
County and intake details come from VA’s FY26 SSVF provider intake list; confirm current service when calling.

source_evidence.scope: County coverage and SSVF intake; Contacts worksheet row 131
